items.title: Deadly attack on Indian cargo ship off coast of Oman
items.description: A crew member was killed in an attack on an Indian cargo vessel off the coast of Oman.

items.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
items.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

items.title: Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region
items.description: Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

items.title: Macron sparks Israel's anger by wrongfully saying Hamas is not active in the West Bank
items.description: During his speech at the United Nations on Tuesday, the French president claimed that Hamas had never operated in the West Bank. This factual error was immediately seized upon by Benjamin Netanyahu to deflect criticism of his settlement policy in the occupied territories.

items.title: Zelensky, 'Putin deve essere fermato, le sanzioni ci rafforzano'
New fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region raises fears of a return to the country's civil war
items.description: Fighting in and around Tigray is testing Ethiopia's fragile 2022 peace deal. With old enemies forming new alliances, experts warn that the conflict could enter a dangerous new phase.

items.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.

items.title: At UN, Trump again threatens Iran, but suggests end of war is near
